text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Wednesday early afternoon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputy parliament chairman Andrius Kubilius presented a new anti-corruption law.

- A planned trip to Russia by a delegation from the parliament foreign affairs committee was cancelled due to technical problems. Some MPs said the trip was stopped after Lithuania was visited by Chechen MPs.
- Austria's new ambassador to Lithuania said Lithuania has to prepare better for negotiations to join the European Union.
